GWA_LatticeEdge.name: Lattice Edge Survey Volume
GWA_LatticeEdge.environment: Reciprocal-field transit space at the boundary between established public routes and uncertified geometry, with anchor infrastructure, probes, survey markers and regions where reference frames can become unreliable.
GWA_LatticeEdge.tone: Objective physical uncertainty: awe comes from measurement behaving strangely, not from mysticism.
GWA_LatticeEdge.political: Route verification determines whether civilian and Fleet traffic may treat a crossing as infrastructure or only as a supervised risk.

GWA_Corridor.name: Unverified Corridor
GWA_Corridor.environment: A red-status public corridor under active re-survey, with a previously used route solution, live shear, local anchors and traffic held outside the crossing.
GWA_Corridor.tone: A road that may still exist but no longer deserves to be trusted by habit.
GWA_Corridor.political: Need does not convert an uncertified route into a safe public route; delay still has real consequences for connected settlements.

GWA_VergeApproach.name: Verge Approach
GWA_VergeApproach.environment: Working convoy space on the frontier side of the route: civilian freighters, relief cargo, patched hulls and limited redundancy waiting on corridor access.
GWA_VergeApproach.political: The cost of caution is borne by real communities, which is why route verification cannot become performative perfectionism.
